newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: bauMax to invest 1 bln ATS in expansion.
newsitem.headline: bauMax to invest 1 bln ATS in expansion.

text.p: Austrian do-it-yourself chain bauMax said on Tuesday it planned to invest around one billion schillings next year in its continued expansion at home and abroad.
The company said it planned to open nine new stores in Austria and neighbouring countries and expand 12 of its existing markets, bringing the overall number of stores to 75 in Austria and 25 abroad.
bauMax, with sales of 6.75 billion schillings last year, is present in Austria, Hungary, the Czech Republic, the Slovak Republic and Slovenia. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
